mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT lp.id FROM logistics_provider lp JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = #{systemUserId} AND u.tenant_id IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.tenant_id IS NULL JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id IS NULL AND r.role_scope = 'PLATFORM' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.permission_code = 'tracking:callback' WHERE lp.provider_code = #{providerCode} AND lp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lp.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT o.tenant_id, o.id AS order_id, o.current_status FROM warehouse_outbound_record w JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id = w.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE w.provider_id = #{providerId} AND w.tracking_no = #{trackingNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_event (tenant_id, provider_id, shipment_order_id, tracking_no, event_id, event_code, event_description, event_time, received_time, raw_payload, process_status, process_message) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{providerId}, #{orderId}, #{trackingNo}, #{eventId}, #{eventCode}, #{description}, #{eventTime}, #{receivedTime}, CAST(#{rawPayload} AS JSON), #{processStatus}, #{processMessage})

INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id, operator_user_id, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, result_status, reason, detail, occurred_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{systemUserId}, 'TRACKING_CALLBACK', 'SHIPMENT_ORDER', #{orderId}, #{requestId}, 'SUCCESS', NULL, CAST(#{detail} AS JSON), #{occurredAt})

INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id, operator_user_id, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, result_status, reason, detail, occurred_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{systemUserId}, 'TRACKING_CALLBACK', 'SHIPMENT_ORDER', #{orderId}, #{requestId}, 'RETAINED', #{reason}, CAST(#{detail} AS JSON), #{occurredAt})
